certificate_semantics.meaning: For the exact rational input recorded in the receipt, the exact rational finite partial sum S_N and an analytic majorant B_N satisfy |F-S_N| <= B_N <= requested_abs_error.

analytic_bounds.mock_theta_omega: 2n(n+1) numerator tail divided by a proved positive lower bound squared for the odd q-product
